subject: Roadmap QBR: schedule shift + ops runbook handshake
messages:
From: Claire Huang <claire@synergro.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Synergro IT <it@synergro.com>
Date: 2028-09-04T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Synergro Roadmap QBR — proposed new window

Hi Priya,

Quick note — our exec team needs to move the Synergro Roadmap QBR that was penciled for the week of Sep 11. We ran into a scheduling conflict with a board review and would prefer to compress the customer-facing portion by a few days if possible.

Would Redwood be able to run the 60-minute QBR + 30-minute technical deep-dive on either:
- Sep 8, 3:00–4:30pm PT, or
- Sep 7, 11:00am–12:30pm PT

If neither works we can look at the following week, but the former is highest priority. Also: two asks from our side before we lock in time:
1) A one-page mutual action plan (MA) we can circulate to legal & procurement (attaching v2).
2) Ops/runbook owners for recording, backup host, and incident escalation during the demo.

Can you confirm availability and who on your team would cover backups?

Thanks — Claire

Attachment: Synergro_QBR_MAPlan_v2.pdf

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Claire Huang <claire@synergro.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-09-04T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Synergro Roadmap QBR — proposed new window

Hi Claire — thanks for the heads up. We can support the earlier window and prefer Sep 8 3:00–4:30pm PT to avoid conflicting customer commitments on Sep 7.

Proposed plan:
- 3:00–4:00pm PT: Business roadmap & product highlights (Priya + Claire)
- 4:00–4:30pm PT: Technical deep-dive (Mateo) — focused on performance/latency improvements and the dedicated/private deployment paths you asked about.

Backup hosts/runbook:
- Primary host: Priya Natarajan (host controls + Q&A)
- Backup host / runbook owner: Marissa Cole (recording, attendee triage, live notes)
- Tech deep-dive: Mateo Alvarez (slides + kernel-level perf notes)

I attached our runbook template for ops handoff. If you can share the attendee list and any compliance constraints (recording/transcription policy) we’ll populate the MA and the runbook prior to the meeting. I’ll also create a calendar invite once we lock time.

Thanks — Priya

Attachment: qbr-runbook-template.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Claire Huang <claire@synergro.com>
Date: 2028-09-05T08:49:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Synergro Roadmap QBR — proposed new window

Looping in a quick ops checklist so we’re aligned:
- Recording consent: Confirm with Synergro legal if we should disable automated transcription.
- Breakout handoff: If the Q&A runs long we’ll move the technical follow-up to a separate session; Mateo will remain as technical lead.
- Incident play: Marissa (backup) will own immediate mitigation (mute/unmute, re-invite) and escalate to Redwood infra if tokens/spikes occur.

I’ll prep the runbook with timestamps + who hits each control and share a short readout by EOD Sep 6.

—Marissa

From: Claire Huang <claire@synergro.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Synergro IT <it@synergro.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-09-06T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Synergro Roadmap QBR — confirmed Sep 8 3pm PT

Thanks all — Sep 8 at 3:00pm PT works for the execs. Calendar invite attached.

A couple of follow-ups from procurement/compliance: 
- Please attach the MA (the PDF you sent looks good; procurement may request one small edit around data residency language).
- For recording/transcription: Synergro legal prefers recordings enabled but transcription disabled by default; we’ll be the custodian for the recording.
- Can you add a short pre-read (3 slides) that covers the proposed performance improvements and the recommended quantization/hosting option? Link to our shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cSYG-pre-read

I’ve attached the invite and shared to our exec calendar.

Claire

Attachments: synergro-qbr-invite.ics

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Claire Huang <claire@synergro.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-09-08T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Synergro Roadmap QBR — final prep and runbook owners

Perfect — confirmed on our side for Sep 8 3:00pm PT. Quick final notes before we go live tomorrow:
- MA: I’ll update the residency clause and re-upload to the shared Drive; expect version v3 by 8am PT Sep 8.
- Recording settings: recording enabled, transcription disabled (we’ll confirm post-call that Synergro has custody).
- Runbook owners: Marissa will run the ops checklist, Mateo owns the tech deep-dive slides and the kernel/quantization appendix, Priya will own the Q&A and exec passback.
- DocuSign: I’ve created the MA envelope (link below) — please sign once the updated version is uploaded.

DocuSign envelope: https://www.docusign.com/envelopes/ABC123syg

See you tomorrow — Priya
